description: Search open vacancies for seafarers on Rynda Crewing. The order is the same for every employer and does not depend on paid plans. Filter by rank, vessel type and minimum monthly salary in USD. Returns up to 20 vacancies per call with pay, contract, joining date and port, vessel, employer and the url of the vacancy page, where the seafarer applies, plus the total number found; use page for more.

min_salary_usd.description: Minimum monthly salary in USD. Vacancies without a stated salary are left out when this is set.

rank.description: Rank (position) as people say it, e.g. "Chief Engineer", "Master", "2nd Officer", "AB", "Bosun", "Cook". Omit to search all ranks.

vessel_type.description: Vessel type code. A group code (e.g. tanker) includes all its subtypes. tanker = Tankers; tanker_oil = Tankers: Crude oil; tanker_product = Tankers: Product; tanker_chemical = Tankers: Chemical; tanker_bunker = Tankers: Bunkering; gas = Gas carriers; dry = Dry cargo ships; dry_bulk = Dry cargo ships: Bulk carriers; dry_general = Dry cargo ships: General cargo and MPP; dry_heavy_lift = Dry cargo ships: Heavy-lift; dry_cement = Dry cargo ships: Cement carriers; container = Container ships; reefer = Reefers; roro = Ro-Ro and car carriers; passenger = Passenger ships and ferries; passenger_cruise = Passenger ships and ferries: Cruise; passenger_ferry = Passenger ships and ferries: Ferries and Ro-Pax; offshore = Offshore; offshore_supply = Offshore: PSV and AHTS; offshore_construction = Offshore: Construction and DSV; offshore_drilling = Offshore: Drilling and FPSO; offshore_crew_boat = Offshore: Crew boats; offshore_survey = Offshore: Survey; tug = Tugs and pushers; tug_towing = Tugs and pushers: Tugs; tug_pusher = Tugs and pushers: Pushers; dredging = Dredgers and technical fleet; fishing = Fishing vessels; research = Research vessels; icebreaker = Icebreakers; service = Service vessels.
